svg.title: Independent gate and coupled-membrane checks
svg.desc: Left: the coupled first-order split method approaches an independent DOP853 reference for an unforced non-equilibrium cell at1ms. Right: fixed opening and closing rates admit an exact exponential gate solution, matched by the substep for any step size. Substep exactness does not remove coupled-system error.
